about: Renovating an apartment in a large residential complex

In a complex of this scale the apartments are very different, but owners share one wish: a predictable budget. So we start with a design project and an estimate where every item has a price, and if our team does the renovation, the final cost stays within ±5% of the estimate.

For comfort- and business-class apartments we advise investing in what is hard to change later: electrics with spare capacity, quality bathroom waterproofing, straight walls and the right layout. Décor and some furniture can be updated later without a renovation.
In a large complex many apartments are renovated at once, and the management company usually regulates noisy-work hours, lifts and waste removal. We plan deliveries so as not to lose time in queues.
For reference: developer — KAN Development, address — 1 Kiltseva Rd. We do not represent the developer or the management company — we work directly with the apartment owner.

faq: How much does an apartment renovation in Respublika cost?

Turnkey renovation starts from $550/m² (labour and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are extra, per the estimate), a design project from $30/m² (minimum $2,500), furnishing from $250/m². The calculation for a 55 m² apartment is in the budget guide above; we fix the exact amount in the estimate after the inspection.
How do I stay within budget?
We fix the estimate before starting. If CAS does the renovation, the final cost stays within ±5% of the estimate.
What should be done well right away, and what can wait?
Right away: electrics, plumbing, waterproofing, levelling and the layout. Décor, some furniture and textiles can be bought later.
We hand over the apartment with a signed acceptance certificate; all completed works carry a 12-month warranty.
Can I follow the renovation remotely?
Yes. We send photo reports from the site via Telegram, and the price, timeline and payment stages are fixed in the contract.
